name: Diodes Incorporated
blurb: Diodes Incorporated is a fabless/hybrid analog and discrete semiconductor company serving automotive, industrial, computing, consumer, and communications markets. Its product portfolio for the AI power-plumbing story includes power MOSFETs, half-bridge and high/low-side gate drivers (600V), smart load switches for GPU and ASIC power domains, AC-DC controllers, DC-DC switching regulators, and LDO voltage references — all targeting server mainboards, power-delivery units, PCIe switches, and networking infrastructure. The company differentiates on a flexible hybrid manufacturing model and broad application-specific standard product (ASSP) coverage across low-to-medium voltage power rails.
recent: Diodes reported Q4 2025 revenue of $391.6 million, up 15.4% year-over-year and ahead of the $387.7 million consensus, marking the highest annual revenue growth since 2021 at 13% for full-year 2025. CEO Gary Yu outlined a long-term target of $2.5 billion in revenue with $1 billion in gross profit. Q1 2026 guidance called for revenue of ~$395 million (±3%), representing approximately 19% year-over-year growth. Note: Q1 2026 results are scheduled for May 7, 2026, and were not yet reported at the time of writing; Q4 2025 is the most recent completed quarter available.
